black-wax.name: Black Wax on the Bell Rope
black-wax.text: The ward-bell was silenced with the same thorn-and-bell wax used by the hidden cult.

sable-dispute.name: Sable's Private Dispute
sable-dispute.text: Warden Sable argued with the bell-keeper hours before the disappearance.

hushed-verse.name: The Hushed Verse
hushed-verse.text: The cult repeats: ‘Name the grief, then ring it home.’

thorn-wound.name: Ritual Thorn Wound
thorn-wound.text: Tovin's wound came from a ritual briar hook, not an animal or ordinary weapon.

bell-true-name.name: The Bell's True Name
bell-true-name.text: The ward-bell was once called Aster Vey, ‘the star that answers.’

sable-payments.name: Sable's Payments
sable-payments.text: A cipher ledger proves Sable funded the cult and sold access to the ward-vault.

wraith-bound.name: The Bound Wraith
wraith-bound.text: The spirit below is the first bell-keeper, bound by Sable's altered ritual rather than willingly hostile.
